#
# The Python packages release.yml's Matter build gate installs, locked with
# hashes (security review 2026-11-21). Installed with
#   pip install --force-reinstall --require-hashes --no-deps
#     --only-binary :all: -r <this file>
# so every package, transitive ones included, must be listed here with its
# exact version and the hash of the one wheel pip may use. --force-reinstall
# matters: an installed version that matches a pin is otherwise "already
# satisfied" with no hash check at all.
#
# Target: CPython 3.12 on x86_64 glibc Linux (setup-python "3.12" on
# ubuntu-24.04). The hash per package is that wheel's, so a different Python
# or platform needs its own wheel hash added, not a looser pin.
#
# Why these: codegen.py (run by chip_codegen on every CHIP build) imports click
# and python_path, and py_matter_idl parses with lark and renders with jinja2;
# codegen.py also imports coloredlogs when it is present (optional, kept
# because the unlocked install had it and a different log path is a
# different build). MarkupSafe (from jinja2) and
# humanfriendly (from coloredlogs) are their only Linux dependencies;
# humanfriendly's pyreadline3 is win32-only and is not needed here. click 8.5
# no longer depends on colorama.
#
# Regenerated 2026-11-22 from PyPI: `pip download --only-binary=:all:
# --platform manylinux2014_x86_64 --python-version 3.12 --implementation cp
# jinja2 lark click python-path coloredlogs`, then `pip hash` on each wheel,
# cross-checked against the sha256 digests PyPI's JSON API publishes.

click==8.5.1 \
    --hash=sha256:8bb5376d2006950386f8c6427613334a2acadc5f559cb80e638d00b4df957e37
coloredlogs==15.0.1 \
    --hash=sha256:612ee75c546f53e92e70049c9dbfcc18c935a2b9a53b66085ce9ef6a6e5c0934
humanfriendly==10.0 \
    --hash=sha256:1697e1a8a8f550fd43c2865cd84542fc175a61dcb779b6fee18cf6b6ccba1477
jinja2==3.1.6 \
    --hash=sha256:85ece4451f492d0c13c5dd7c13a64681a86afae63a5f347908daf103ce6d2f67
lark==1.3.1 \
    --hash=sha256:c629b661023a014c37da873b4ff58a817398d12635d3bbb2c5a03be7fe5d1e12
markupsafe==3.0.4 \
    --hash=sha256:8e124f974786f831d6043728e38296969d3579db8896fe004682f5758e613581
python-path==0.1.2 \
    --hash=sha256:6a931878ac6e40a924221ba1f371fb5b60fd58f12c5b7fab48b27c34a0f034a2
